answer:
Vera Barbosa was born in **Vila Franca de Xira**, which is located in the **Lisbon District** of Portugal.

Portugal is divided into 18 districts, and Vila Franca de Xira is one of the municipalities within the Lisbon District, situated northeast of Lisbon on the Tagus River.
